body:
`gittoc claim T-1` defaults owner to $GITTOC_OWNER/$USER, but the same transition via `gittoc update T-1 --state claimed` leaves owner="" — a claimed ticket nobody owns. resume's claimed-by-owner selection will never surface it.

Fix: default the owner inside update_issue on the open->claimed transition when none is given (mirroring cmd_claim), or reject claimed-without-owner with a clear message. Defaulting is more consistent with claim.
title: Default owner on open->claimed transition via update
